desc: Semi-automatic, gas operated action. Features a 20 inch contoured barrel. Polymer handguard. Upper receiver manufactured from an aluminum alloy. Manual safety located on the left side of the receiver above the pistol grip. Top of the receiver features a A-2 carrying handle and integral picatinny rail for mounting rear sights, or any optical accesories. Beaded front sight. Serration on receiver rear sight. Chambered for 2-3/4 or 3 inch Magnum loads. Comes packaged in a commercial box with chokes and magazine.
